endpoints.name: coins_list_with_market_data
endpoints.summary: To query all the supported coins with price, market cap, volume and market related data

query_params.name: vs_currency
query_params.description: Target currency of coins and market data. *refers to /simple/supported_vs_currencies

query_params.name: ids
query_params.description: Coins' IDs, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin. *refers to /coins/list

query_params.name: names
query_params.description: Coins' names, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin.

query_params.name: symbols
query_params.description: Coins' symbols, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin.

query_params.name: include_tokens
query_params.description: For symbols lookups, specify all to include all matching tokens. Default top returns top-ranked tokens by market cap or volume.

query_params.name: category
query_params.description: Filter based on coins' category. *refers to /coins/categories/list

query_params.name: order
query_params.description: Sort result by field. Default: market_cap_desc

query_params.name: per_page
query_params.description: Total results per page. Default: 100 Valid values: 1...250

query_params.name: page
query_params.description: Page through results. Default: 1

query_params.name: sparkline
query_params.description: Include sparkline 7-day data. Default: false

query_params.name: price_change_percentage
query_params.description: Include price change percentage timeframe, comma-separated if querying more than 1 timeframe. Valid values: 1h, 24h, 7d, 14d, 30d, 200d, 1y

query_params.name: locale
query_params.description: Language background. Default: en

query_params.name: precision
query_params.description: Decimal places for currency price value

query_params.name: include_rehypothecated
query_params.description: Include rehypothecated tokens in results. When true, returns market_cap_rank_with_rehypothecated field. Default: false

endpoints.notes: Filter by ids, names, symbols, or category. When multiple are provided, priority is: category > ids > names > symbols. URL-encode spaces in names (e.g. Binance%20Coin). include_tokens=all only works with symbols lookups, limited to 50 symbols per request. Maximum of 250 IDs per request. Wildcard searches are not supported. Use per_page and page to paginate results. Filter by category using the category param â€” refer to Coins Categories List (/reference/coins-categories-list) for available values. Cache / Update Frequency: Every 30 seconds (Paid API), Every 60 seconds (Demo / Keyless API).

endpoints.name: coin_price_by_ids_symbols_or_names
endpoints.summary: To query the prices of one or more coins by using their unique Coin API IDs, symbols, or names

query_params.name: vs_currencies
query_params.description: Target currency of coins, comma-separated if querying more than 1 currency. *refers to /simple/supported_vs_currencies

query_params.name: ids
query_params.description: Coins' IDs, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin. *refers to /coins/list

query_params.name: names
query_params.description: Coins' names, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin.

query_params.name: symbols
query_params.description: Coins' symbols, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin.

query_params.name: include_tokens
query_params.description: For symbols lookups, specify all to include all matching tokens. Default top returns top-ranked tokens by market cap or volume.

query_params.name: include_market_cap
query_params.description: Include market capitalization. Default: false

query_params.name: include_24hr_vol
query_params.description: Include 24-hour trading volume. Default: false

query_params.name: include_24hr_change
query_params.description: Include 24-hour change percentage. Default: false

query_params.name: include_last_updated_at
query_params.description: Include last updated price time as a UNIX timestamp. Default: false

query_params.name: precision
query_params.description: Decimal places for currency price value

endpoints.notes: You can look up coins by ids, names, or symbols. When multiple are provided, priority is: ids > names > symbols. Find a coinâ€™s API ID on its CoinGecko (https://www.coingecko.com) page, via Coins List (/reference/coins-list), or this Google Sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wTTuxXt8n9q7C4NDXqQpI3wpKu1_5bGVmP9Xz0XGSyU/edit?usp=sharing). Use include_last_updated_at=true or include_24hr_change=true (returns null if stale) to verify price freshness. include_tokens=all only works with symbols lookups, limited to 50 symbols per request. Maximum of 515 IDs per request. Wildcard searches are not supported. URL-encode spaces in names (e.g. Binance%20Coin). Cross-check prices on CoinGecko (https://www.coingecko.com) and learn about the price methodology (https://www.coingecko.com/en/methodology). Cache / Update Frequency: Every 20 seconds (Paid API), Every 60 seconds (Demo / Keyless API).
